necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and documented episodes of supraventricular tachycardia and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, complicated by recent unexplained syncope. To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and establish a correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and syncopal events, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93247 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
